protocol.calendar_rule: each available month: nearest distinct dates to day 5/15/25 with all 24 clock slots; tie chooses earlier date; minute 15*(hour%4)
protocol.mc_replicates: K1: draws 0,8,16,24; K8: four disjoint blocks within the same 32 draws
protocol.comparisons: paired seeds/dates/farms; macro-farm MAE and RMSE; high-power/downturn and >0.3 change bins
limitations: R4-ISO is an immutable interim best-MAE checkpoint, not final completed training
Two seeds and 33 sampled days are screening only; no main gate is declared
Frozen original validation cohort has no November origins; audit does not alter it
Coverage/CRPS are marginal diagnostics; latent samples need not form calibrated power forecasts
No low-dimensional flow training is launched without a useful initial signal

note: The audit was run on frozen interim checkpoints. After training completed, both audited R4-ISO weights were verified byte-identical to their final selected checkpoints. This does not expand the audit beyond two seeds and 33 sampled dates. The original validation cohort has no November origins.
